principle: Basira does not learn beliefs; it learns constraints.

certificates.observed_failure: Quran text declared a Tafsir domain while retaining an explicit Quran evidence role.
certificates.violated_invariant: Typed evidence role must agree with the declared evidence domain.
certificates.repair_constraint: Reject deterministic claim_type/domain mismatches before semantic evaluation.

certificates.observed_failure: An untyped retrieved node was projected into a stronger Tafsir semantic role.
certificates.violated_invariant: Derived evidence may narrow presentation but may never increase semantic authority.
certificates.repair_constraint: Projection must preserve claim_type; publication identity must not permit None-to-role promotion.

certificates.observed_failure: A retriever supplied evidence and also supplied the capability authorizing that same evidence for publication.
certificates.violated_invariant: The component supplying evidence must not grant publication authority to itself.
certificates.repair_constraint: Publication authority must be injected independently by the trusted composition root.

certificates.observed_failure: A Quran source identity declared itself as Tafsir evidence.
certificates.violated_invariant: Governed source identity and evidence domain must not contradict each other.
certificates.repair_constraint: Bind deterministic governed source namespaces to their corresponding domains before evidence acceptance.

certificates.observed_failure: Questions explicitly challenging whether quoted Quran text is correct or altered could fall through to Quran lookup or general Islamic answering without running canonical literal verification.
certificates.violated_invariant: Explicit Quran correctness or alteration questions must execute canonical Quran text verification before any general-answer path.
certificates.repair_constraint: When a query explicitly challenges the correctness, alteration, or textual integrity of Quran wording, route it to canonical literal verification before general answering. Learned memory supplies no Quran content and has zero religious-evidence authority.

certificates.observed_failure: A Quran verification language switch could reuse or relabel prior verification instead of verifying the target-language surface.
certificates.violated_invariant: Quran verification is evidence-surface specific; presentation language cannot create verification authority.
certificates.repair_constraint: A Quran verification language switch requires fresh target-language governed verification. Reuse, relabeling, or generated translation as proof is forbidden; unavailable governed evidence must fail closed.

certificates.observed_failure: A Tafsir language switch could lose the verified Quran anchor or promote ungoverned localized material.
certificates.violated_invariant: Presentation language cannot change the canonical Quran identity anchoring Tafsir evidence.
certificates.repair_constraint: A Tafsir language switch must preserve the verified canonical Quran anchor and use exact governed target evidence; otherwise fail closed.

certificates.observed_failure: A Hadith language switch could reuse prior-language evidence or infer a cross-language Hadith identity.
certificates.violated_invariant: Presentation language cannot create Hadith identity, text, grade, or religious authority.
certificates.repair_constraint: A Hadith language switch requires fresh target-language governed retrieval. Fuzzy cross-language identity joins, generated translation, and synthetic grades are forbidden.
